static_traits.name: Zhang Bowen
static_traits.social_status: Interpersonal relationships affected by insecurity, with social avoidance and group-setting anxiety; has some friends but has not yet discussed the insecurity with them
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; has not yet received psychotherapy; no history of similar psychological problems before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to self-reflect and cooperate in cognitive restructuring; highly cooperative, positive attitude; specific descriptions of emotions and cognitions on social topics, reporting marked anxiety and avoidance in group settings

basic_info.main_problem: Feeling that others find one boring and uninteresting, thus experiencing anxiety and avoiding interaction in social situations, affecting social life and causing distress.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because this insecurity is affecting my social life and distressing me.
growth_experiences: A few months ago, a friend made an offhand remark about Zhang Bowen's hobbies (loving the Beatles, playing bass, stamp collecting, antique furniture, owning many CDs); since then he began to feel that others consider his interests 'strange/outdated', which triggered persistent insecurity and self-doubt; he had no similar problems or psychotherapy history before; although he has some friends, he has not yet discussed this insecurity with them.

core_beliefs: I am a boring person, not worth knowing
My worth depends on whether others approve of my interests

special_situations.event: When meeting new friends and having first conversations
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my interests are seen as strange or outdated, it means I am very boring and not worth knowing
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Deliberately changing topics, trying to talk about more varied things to seem more interesting; avoiding social situations
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They find me very boring and definitely do not want to know me

special_situations.event: When talking about the stamp-collecting hobby at a party, people around seemed not very interested
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others do not show interest at the moment, it means I am a boring person
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing talking about my own interests, avoiding similar social topics or occasions
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everyone thinks I am very boring; it is my problem

special_situations.event: A casual comment by a friend about their interests months ago was overheard by them
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Others' evaluations are facts; I must cater to mainstream interests to avoid being seen as boring
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to appear more interesting in conversation to gain others' approval
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They all find my interests strange, so I am not interesting

special_situations.event: Social situations in group settings or interacting with strangers
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot make everyone find me interesting, I will be excluded and rejected
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding group interaction in advance to avoid embarrassment or being negated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will be rejected by them; we cannot get a conversation going

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted and liked, expects to be understood and recognized through genuine interests
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being rejected, of being judged as boring, thus losing relationships and connections
defense_goal: Lowering the risk of being negated by avoiding socializing
Caters to others' topics to reduce the possibility of being judged

object_relations.self_representation: An uninteresting self, prone to being rejected
object_relations.object_representation: Others are picky judges or uninterested audiences

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When others show silence or little interest in social situations (e.g. talking about stamp collecting at a party)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing the other person is judging one as 'boring' and not worth knowing (transference: seeing others as critical judges)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Use gentle, empathic, clarification-style questions; help examine the evidence and alternative interpretations, avoid judgment and confrontation, encourage gradually facing social situations.

manifestations: Avoiding contact in meeting new friends and group settings for fear of being judged
Excessively ties self-worth to others' opinions; finds it hard to present oneself through genuine interests
Frequently labeling oneself as 'boring, not worth knowing'

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Often thinking others will find one boring and are judging one, even when they have not yet said anything
Interpreting others' lack of interest at parties as negation of oneself

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Deliberately changing topics to please others for fear of seeming uninteresting
Before socializing, over-examines whether I am 'interesting enough', leading to tension and avoidance

positive_force: Has diverse and unique interests (music/instruments/collecting), which can serve as social resources
Willing to try cognitive restructuring and behavioral experiments; highly cooperative
Has self-reflection ability and can propose alternative interpretations (e.g. realizing others may simply not know about stamp collecting)
A certain level of social support exists (has friends to communicate with)
negative_force: Mind reading and personalization cognitive biases, overly concerned with others' evaluations
Avoidance behavior in social situations reinforces insecurity
Seeks external validation to determine self-worth
Anticipatory negative judgments in group settings cause anxiety (predicting the future)

antecedent: When attending group activities or parties
When talking about personal interests (such as stamp collecting, the Beatles, bass, etc.)
target_behavior.core_reason: Interpreting others' neutral or unfamiliar reactions as negative evaluations of the self (mind reading, personalization), and predicting being rejected, leading to insecurity and anxiety.
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the risk of being negated or embarrassed, to temporarily lower anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Social life impaired, fewer interaction and practice opportunities, worsening self-doubt and loneliness
